dct_title_s: Map of the White Earth Indian Reservation, Minnesota, 1910
dct_alternative_sm: Map of the White Earth Indian Reservation, Minnesota, 1910
dct_description_sm: Cartographic Details: Scale [1:79,000] Shows township, range and section lines, settlements, schools, mission, agency, sawmill, resettlement land, tribal lands.
Map is part of "Helen Parker Mudgett papers" collection in the University of Minnesota Archives.
